objections.about: The customer says they have already spent 2 days going back and forth in chat, and the reply sends them back to the same chat. It doesn't acknowledge this, and a team member should handle a customer who is stuck after repeated chat attempts.

The customer's underlying problem is never identified or addressed. The reply only declines the Zoom call and repeats generic chat advice, so it gives no route to resolving what has gone unresolved for 2 days.
